title: Interteam Dependency Crosswalk and Release Gating Protocol
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Define and operationalize a lightweight crosswalk + gating protocol that converts roadmap dependency signals into deterministic release gates across Eng, Design, Security, and Infra. The goal is to reduce surprise blockers during cutover windows by combining: (1) a shared dependency manifest (crosswalk) with explicit artifact handoffs, and (2) telemetry-driven gating thresholds surfaced in a readiness dashboard and gating automations. This ticket scopes the product/ops definition, gating rules, and the minimal automation required to create/update dependency tickets and surface a single 'release-ready' flag for each initiative.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Dependency crosswalk template (YAML/Confluence) adopted by Eng/Design/Security/Infra and referenced in PRD templates. 2) Readiness dashboard prototype shows per-initiative signals: API contract signoff, design assets blocked, security review status, infra capacity slots. 3) Automated rule engine marks initiative as 'gate: blocked/warn/green' based on threshold logic and posts a summary in the release Slack channel. 4) Rollout runnable for next minor release (canary with two initiatives).
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Product definition + templates (2 sprints). Phase 2: Lightweight telemetry ingestion (existing dashboards + 3 new signals) and gating rules implemented in Console as a feature flag. Phase 3: Automation to create dependency tickets in Linear and to post gating results to Slack/Console. Rely on Eng infra for instrumentation: events from CI, security-review webhook, design versioning tag. We will avoid heavy process changes: aim for machine-readable artifacts that teams can opt into.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Teams don't populate crosswalk -> Mitigation: make template minimal and add to PRD/initiative creation flow; run a pilot with 3 product teams. Risk: False positives from telemetry -> Mitigation: add a 24-hour grace window and manual override with audit trail. Risk: Over-automation causing churn -> Mitigation: start with read-only gating (badges + Slack) before enabling blockers.
